content: Recharts about 150KB gzipped monolithic; visx modular SVG primitives about 30 to 40KB gzip typical chart from 4 to 6 packages; lightweight-charts (TradingView, canvas-based) about 45KB, built for dense time-series. For this projects low-density solar-activity timeline, visx recommended: smaller footprint alongside an already-heavy WebGL bundle, SVG easier to style and interact per-event than canvas, and compose-from-primitives philosophy matches the vanilla-Three.js learning approach elsewhere in the project.
